title: 第7章 性感美艳的女医生
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮说的头头是道，张桂芬虽然不信儿子真能把老伴手指接上，但却点相信他可能真不傻了！

    傻子说话可不会这么利索！

    “爸妈，大壮确实不傻了！”李秋霜用力的对爸妈点点头。

    李家二老这才彻底信了，巨大的惊喜充斥着二老的心灵，张桂芬激动的拍着儿子结实的臂膀，泪水再次模糊了双眼：

    “好好好！大壮你可算是好了！老天爷终于开了回眼啊！”

    李守义也颤抖着说：“我……我这手更不用……治了，大壮好了，攒钱给……给他娶媳妇！”

    李大壮看着身形佝偻苍老的父母，心中酸涩无比，眼眶也有些湿润：“爸妈，别的咱们回家再说，但现在，我得赶紧给我爸把手指接上！”

    “请问你们这儿有针灸用的银针吗？能借我用一下吗？”李大壮对诊室里的医生护士问道。

    “病人家属，你们确定你家这位男士真的不傻了吗？以我从医多年的经验来看，他可不只是傻，还傻的挺严重呢！”

    一位上了年纪的男医生不客气的说：“你们自己听听他刚才说的话，还用针灸接骨连肉，简直就是笑话，他要真有这本事，我副院长的位置给他坐！”

    几个长相风骚的小护士，也都面露嘲笑，一副看傻子的表情看着李大壮，只有一个性感美艳，婀娜多姿的漂亮女医生，一脸焦急的说：“各位，现在不是赌气的时候，赶紧把病人送去县医院才是正事！”

    “断指再接上的最佳黄金时间只有六到八小时，现在已经过去两小时了，你们到县城还需要至少半个小时，每一分钟都很紧急！”

    “谢谢你的提醒，不过我真的不是在说傻话，如果你能帮我拿副银针来，等我帮我爸的手指接上，可以免费帮你治疗大小胸的问题！”

    李大壮一眼就看出来，这位漂亮的女医生，胸一个大一个小，虽然她用硅胶垫，把小的那个垫高了，但拥有媚儿传承的李大壮，眼力可不一般！

    女医生精致美艳的脸蛋瞬间通红，看似丰满圆润的前胸，因为急切的喘息上下起伏，红唇惊的微微张开，美眸全是难以置信！

    她激动的脱口而出：“我明明在内衣里放了乳胶垫，别人都没发现，你个傻子是怎么看出来的！？”

    诊室众人，纷纷惊讶的张大了嘴巴，那个傻子说的竟然是真的！

Although the gangsters didn't know who the visitor was, Li Dazhuang had such a powerful aura and terrifying murderous intent!

Make them tremble involuntarily!

"Roar!!"

However, Xiaomei let out an excited roar, ran to Li Dazhuang's feet, rubbed his calf affectionately, and looked up at him arrogantly, with a cute look asking for credit!

This scene scared those guys!

That's a tiger!

The boss was knocked down by it and scratched his paw, causing blood to flow all over the floor. He fainted now, which shows how ferocious it is!

But such a ferocious beast would actually act coquettishly towards this person. Who the hell is this person!?

"I heard that you are looking for me? You also said that if I can't come back in half an hour, my house will be turned into a garbage dump?" Li Dazhuang asked with murderous intent, which made a few people understand his identity!

But he was even more frightened. This young man with such a strong aura that he could even tame a tiger turned out to be Li Dazhuang!!!

"Brother Qiang! Aren't you harming us? The Li Dazhuang you mentioned is just a wild man from a small mountain village, but it turns out that he is a master who can tame tigers!"

One guy collapsed and yelled at the fainted bald head on the ground!

The bald man's name is Wang Qiang, and he is looking for Li Dazhuang!

Several other people quickly apologized to Li Dazhuang and explained: "Mr. Li, I'm really sorry. We were also deceived by Brother Qiang. We really didn't mean to target you!"

"We all know our mistake. Please let us go. We promise not to come back again!"

"Come and leave as soon as you say, and you dare to threaten my family. Do you think I'm Ni Nie's?" Li Dazhuang stopped talking nonsense to them and rushed forward!

No one saw how he moved. When he stopped, those tall guys either had broken arms and legs, or were lying on the ground with bruises and swollen noses, wailing!

Li Dazhuang wanted to continue, but Zhang Guifen and Li Qiu Shuang shouted in unison: "Dazhuang stop!!"

"Just beat them away. Don't take your life for such bad people!"

"Yes, Da Zhuang, just listen to mom, that's all!"

The people on the ground didn't bother to cry out in pain, and begged for mercy again and again: "Okay... please spare your life, good man! Don't kill us!"

"We know we were wrong. You are a real master and not someone we can afford to offend. We will never dare to come here again!"

"Please spare our lives!"

Li Dazhuang didn't want his mother and Sister Qiu Shuang to worry, so he stopped his hand and looked down at those guys: "Stop barking! If you bark again, my little beauty will tear you apart!"

Several people were so frightened that they quickly shut up.
